as_told.title: Alex Jones' CNN call warning Osama bin Laden about the Twin Towers

plain: Before the 2001 attacks, the broadcaster Alex Jones said on air that if a terrorist group hit the World Trade Center, everyone would know who to blame, according to Jesse Michels. Michels tells this himself in two conversations with the writer Eric Wargo about seeing the future, and in the second he places the remark on CNN, addressed to Osama bin Laden: "if you take down the Twin Towers I'm gonna come after you." He offers it as a possible case of knowing about an event before it happened.
